an5.26:0.3:
The question has been sometimes asked: If right concentration is essential to gaining even the first level of awakening, how is it that people can gain awakening while listening to a Dhamma talk? This sutta shows how the act of listening to a Dhamma talk is one way of gaining the inspiration that leads to right concentration.

See also: MN 7; SN 55:40; AN 3:96; AN 5:151; AN 6:86–88
an5.26:2.2: For examples of people gaining release on hearing the Dhamma, see SN 22:59 and SN 35:28.
an5.26:3.1: For an example of a person gaining release while teaching the Dhamma, see SN 22:89.
an5.26:5.8: This would be a case of tranquility preceded by insight. See AN 4:170.
an5.26:6.2: According to MN 44, the themes of right concentration are the four establishings of mindfulness. See also AN 5:28.
